color.$description: Theme-private palette. Resolved at build time and never emitted as CSS custom properties.

cerulean.$description: Cerulean hue: calm, technical, trustworthy blue. One ladder derived from the designer-provided accents for both modes: 50-400 carry the brighter (dark-surface) end, 500-950 the deeper (light-surface) end, and 700 is the brightest step that still passes WCAG AA as text on white.
